arxiv-2103-01894.title: Investigations on Audiovisual Emotion Recognition in Noisy Conditions
arxiv-2103-01894.creator: Michael Neumann, Ngoc Thang Vu
arxiv-2103-01894.description: Abstract In this paper we explore audiovisual emotion recognition under noisy acoustic conditions with a focus on speech features. We attempt to answer the following research questions: (i) How does speech emotion recognition perform on noisy data? and (ii) To what extend does a multimodal approach improve the accuracy and compensate for potential performance degradation at different noise levels?

arxiv-2109-07528.title: Recurrence relations for off-shell Bethe vectors
arxiv-2109-07528.creator: in trigonometric integrable models
arxiv-2109-07528.description: Abstract Abstract. The zero modes method is applied in order to get action of the monodromy matrix entries onto off-shell Bethe vectors in quantum integrable models associated with U_{q}(\mathfrak{gl}_{N}) -invariant {\rm R} -matrices. The action formulas allow to get recurrence relations for off-shell Bethe vectors and for highest coefficients of the Bethe vectors scalar product.

arxiv-2301-03467.title: ORKA: Accelerated Kaczmarz Algorithms for Signal Recovery from One-Bit Samples Thanks: This work was supported in part by National Science Foundation Grant CCF-1704401. The first two authors contributed equally to this work. Thanks: A. Eamaz, F. Yeganegi and M. Soltanalian are with the Department of
arxiv-2301-03467.creator: Arian Eamaz, Farhang Yeganegi, Deanna Needell, and
arxiv-2301-03467.description: Abstract One-bit quantization with time-varying sampling thresholds has recently found significant utilization potential in statistical signal processing applications due to its relatively low power consumption and low implementation cost. In addition to such advantages, an attractive feature of one-bit analog-to-digital converters (ADCs) is their superior sampling rates as compared to their conventional multi-bit counterparts.

arxiv-2301-08578.title: The formation of hard VHE spectra from GRB afterglow via Two-Zone Synchrotron Self-Compton Emission
arxiv-2301-08578.creator: Dmitry Khangulyan, Andrew M. Taylor, Felix Aharonian
arxiv-2301-08578.description: Abstract Electron Compton scattering of target photons into the gamma-ray energy band (inverse Compton scattering –IC–) is commonly expected to dominate the very high energy spectra in gamma-ray bursts especially during the afterglow phase. For sufficiently large center-of-mass energies in these collisions, the effect of the electron recoil starts reducing the scattering cross section (the Klein-Nishina regime).

arxiv-2312-03117.title: Fractal packing of nanomaterials
arxiv-2312-03117.creator: Dietrich E. Wolf, Thorsten Pöschel
arxiv-2312-03117.description: Abstract Cohesive particles form agglomerates that are usually very porous. Their geometry, particularly their fractal dimension, depends on the agglomeration process (diffusion-limited or ballistic growth by adding single particles or cluster-cluster aggregation). However, in practice, the packing structure depends not only on the initial formation but also on the mechanical processing of the agglomerate after it has grown.

arxiv-2402-11994.title: Rotation invariant webs for three row flamingo Specht modules
arxiv-2402-11994.creator: Jesse Kim
arxiv-2402-11994.description: Abstract . We introduce a new rotation-invariant web basis for a family of Specht modules S ( d 3 , 1 n − 3 ​ d ) S^{(d^{3},1^{n-3d})} , indexed by normal plabic graphs satisfying a degree condition and resembling A 2 A_{2} webs.

arxiv-2502-02573.title: Are Language Models Up to Sequential Optimization Problems? From Evaluation to a Hegelian-Inspired Enhancement
arxiv-2502-02573.creator: Soheil Abbasloo Microsoft Research soheil.abbasloo@microsoft.com
arxiv-2502-02573.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities across numerous fields, presenting an opportunity to revolutionize optimization problem-solving, a crucial, ubiquitous, and complex domain. This paper explores the proficiency of LLMs in handling Sequential Optimization Problems (SOPs). We introduce WorldGen, a dynamic framework for generating unseen SOPs with controllable complexities, to evaluate LLM performance.

arxiv-2511-07291.title: Diffusion-Reaction Epidemic Model with a Free Boundary Thanks: This work was supported by the Ministry of Education of the Republic of Korea and the National Research Foundation of Korea (RS-2025-00515707)
arxiv-2511-07291.creator: Aesol Jeon, Ki-Ahm Lee
arxiv-2511-07291.description: Abstract . This study investigates an SEIS PDE model with a free boundary, which captures the dynamics of epidemic transmission, including diseases like COVID-19. This parabolic PDE system is analyzed in a rotationally symmetric domain, and the existence and uniqueness of the local solution are established through the straightening lemma.

arxiv-2601-05994.title: Setting up the physical principles of resilience in a model of the Earth System
arxiv-2601-05994.creator: Orfeu Bertolami, Magnus Nyström
arxiv-2601-05994.description: Abstract Resilience is a property of social, ecological, social-ecological and biophysical systems. It describes the capacity of a system to cope with, adapt to and innovate in response to a changing surrounding. Given the current climate change crisis, ensuring conditions for a sustainable future for the habitability on the planet is fundamentally dependent on Earth System (ES) resilience.

pmc-10691420.title: THE ROLE OF CORE SELF-EVALUATIONS AND EGO-RESILIENCY IN PREDICTING RESOURCE LOSSES AND GAINS IN THE FACE OF THE COVID-19 CRISIS: THE PERSPECTIVE OF CONSERVATION OF RESOURCES THEORY
pmc-10691420.creator: Elżbieta Sanecka, Marta Stasiła-Sieradzka, Elżbieta Turska

pmc-11520389.title: Enablers and barriers of community health programs for improved equity and universal coverage of primary health care services: A scoping review
pmc-11520389.creator: Resham B Khatri, Aklilu Endalamaw, Daniel Erku, Eskinder Wolka, Frehiwot Nigatu, Anteneh Zewdie, Yibeltal Assefa
pmc-11520389.description: BackgroundCommunity health programs (CHPs) are integral components of primary health care (PHC) systems and support the delivery of primary care and allied health and nursing care services. CHPs are necessary platforms for delivering health services toward universal health coverage (UHC).

pmc-12495675.title: Kaempferol triggers cellular senescence via CDK1 ubiquitination in HCC cells
pmc-12495675.creator: Damin Liang, Min Tian, Guomei Hu, Yu Zhang, Lunyou Zhang, Juqi Chen, Xin Shen, Huayong Jian, Peng Tian, Tingchao Li, Xiaoju Cheng
pmc-12495675.description: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is a common malignancy with poor prognosis. Cellular senescence, a state linked to cell cycle arrest, represents a potential therapeutic strategy for cancer. However, the clinical impact and regulatory mechanism of cellular senescence in HCC remains incompletely unknown. We identified HCC associated differentially expressed genes (DEGs) using bioinformatics analysis of public databases (TCGA, GEO, GEPIA, etc.).

pmc-12565451.title: Methodologies for Detoxifying Bivalves from Marine Paralytic Shellfish Toxins
pmc-12565451.creator: Adewale Aderogba, Joana F Leal, Maria L S Cristiano, Jiangbing Qiu, Yang Liu
pmc-12565451.description: The marine environment emerges as a key provider of food and sustainable products. However, these benefits are accompanied by numerous challenges owing to harmful algal blooms (HAB) and their associated biotoxins, which accumulate in organisms, like bivalves, threatening seafood quality.

pmc-12727176.title: Investigating the relationship between temporomandibular disorders and personality traits
pmc-12727176.creator: Alessandro Marchesi, Rachele Buttironi, Andrea Sardella
pmc-12727176.description: Background: This observational study investigates the potential link between temporomandibular disorders (TMD) and personality disorders. The Personality Inventory for Diagnostic and statistical manual of mental disorders (DSM)-5-Brief Form (PID-5-BF) was used to assess personality traits, while TMD diagnosis was established by combining dental and clinical history with specific screening questionnaires, including the TMD-Pain Screener.

pmc-12787358.title: Performance of Warm Mix Asphalt with Polymer Modified RAP Using Recycled Engine Oil and SBS Binder Modification
pmc-12787358.creator: Byung-Sik Ohm, Tri Ho Minh Le
pmc-12787358.description: The growing use of reclaimed asphalt pavement (RAP) in warm-mix asphalt (WMA) presents significant challenges when RAP originates from aged polymer-modified binder (PMB) pavements, where severe oxidation and polymer degradation lead to excessive stiffness and poor cracking resistance. This study presents a multi-scale evaluation of a hybrid modification strategy combining recycled engine oil waste (REOW, 3 wt.

pmc-13283990.title: Investigation of carbohydrate-based molecules of Theileria parva parasites
pmc-13283990.creator: Jeannine Kolakowski, Shi Yan, Johannes Stadlmann, Bernd Lepenies, Daniel Ngugi, Heather Harris, Dirk Werling
pmc-13283990.description: Theileria parva (Tp), the causative agent of East Coast Fever, poses a major threat to Bos taurus cattle in sub-Saharan Africa. Progress towards a stable, affordable, cross-protective subunit vaccine covering more than one major histocompatibility complex (MHC)-presented Tp antigen has been hindered by the limited knowledge of antigens.

pmc-13381890.title: A generalist precision medication framework using temporal causal inference based on treatment-free physiological profiles
pmc-13381890.creator: Zizhen Deng, Wei Wu, Chi Zhang, Xitong Zhao, Minghao Pu, Yanbin Bu, Yanfeng Liao, Changguan Wang, Jiarui Yang, Yanni Wang, Jinzhuo Wang
pmc-13381890.description: Heterogeneity in treatment responses to standard treatment regimens poses a critical challenge in clinical practice, compounded by the unobservability of counterfactual outcomes. To address this, we present temporal causal precision medication (TCPM), a generalist framework translating routine physiological indicators into personalized treatment strategies.
